integrity: The three-distance factor-frequency theorem is prior mathematics; the newly assessed contribution is the arithmetic-density classification across block lengths. All computational checks are finite and support, rather than replace, the infinite proof. An earlier unindexed equivalent may exist.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Fibonacci Sturmian shift, its unique invariant probability, each fixed q>0 and strictly interior deficit threshold; not claims for q<=0, endpoint thresholds, arbitrary Sturmian slopes or statistical convergence rates.
title: Exact ordinary and logarithmic density laws for exceptional Fibonacci block-entropy lengths
